reason: My clients, contracts and invoices already live in HoneyBook and my hours in Toggl, and this doesn't do either, so it would be one more app next to them, not one fewer. I might poke at the free plan, but I wouldn't pay $12 a month on top of what I already pay.
objection: It doesn't touch invoicing or time tracking, which is the part of my business that actually makes money, and I'd be moving my whole client history into a new startup that might not be around in a year.
would_change_my_mind: If it handled invoices and time tracking well enough that I could cancel HoneyBook and Toggl, so it saves me money instead of adding a subscription.
